alternatives: Alternative: Replace a roller support with a fixed pin support if horizontal thrust restraint is available at both abutments.
Alternative: If an inclined roller is intended, specify the normal constraint direction explicitly.
engineering_rationale: Under static equilibrium equations (ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0), a 2D planar body possesses 3 rigid-body degrees of freedom. Without 3 non-concurrent, non-parallel constraints, the equilibrium coefficient matrix is rank-deficient and cannot resist arbitrary loads.

proposed_fixes.description: Assigns a Pin Support (restraining X & Y) at Joint J1 and a Roller Support (restraining Y) at Joint J2, providing the 3 non-parallel reaction components required for stable equilibrium.
proposed_fixes.title: Apply standard support layout: Pin at J1, Roller at J2

root_cause_explanation: The structure has only 0 support constraint(s). Planar 2D static equilibrium requires at least 3 non-parallel reaction components to prevent rigid-body translation and rotation.
